scenarios.title: A permanent whose dash cost was paid has haste

setup.notes: Mardu Scout is a 3/1 with mana cost {R}{R} and dash {1}{R}.

decisions: A casts Mardu Scout for its dash cost {1}{R}, tapping both Mountains; the spell resolves.
A moves to combat and declares Mardu Scout as an attacker against B.
B declares no blockers; combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Mardu Scout has haste, attacks and deals 3 damage. B is at 17.

variants.label: cast-normally
variants.delta: A casts Mardu Scout for its mana cost {R}{R} instead.
variants.expected: Mardu Scout is summoning sick and cannot attack. B stays at 20.

operation.unclassifiable: choice: A casts for the mana cost instead of dashing

scenarios.title: A dashed permanent returns to its owner's hand at the beginning of the next end step

setup.notes: Mardu Scout is a 3/1 with mana cost {R}{R} and dash {1}{R}. In the base variant B's Grizzly Bears does not block.

decisions: A casts Mardu Scout for its dash cost {1}{R}, tapping both Mountains; the spell resolves.
A attacks B with Mardu Scout; B declares no blockers and combat damage is dealt.
Play proceeds to the beginning of the end step.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: At the beginning of the end step Mardu Scout returns to A's hand. B took 3 damage and is at 17.

variants.label: cast-normally
variants.delta: A casts Mardu Scout for its mana cost {R}{R}, and does not attack with it.
variants.expected: No delayed trigger exists. Mardu Scout is still on the battlefield at the end step.

operation.unclassifiable: choice: A casts for the mana cost instead of dashing

variants.label: dies-first
variants.delta: B blocks Mardu Scout with Grizzly Bears, so Mardu Scout dies in combat damage before the end step.
variants.expected: Mardu Scout deals 3 damage to Grizzly Bears (dies) and takes 2, so it goes to A's graveyard. At the end step it is not returned: it is in the graveyard, not in A's hand.

operation.unclassifiable: choice: B blocks Mardu Scout with Grizzly Bears

detector.outcome: The delayed trigger a dash-cast permanent's spell creates fires at the beginning of the next end step and returns the permanent to its owner's hand.
detector.near_miss: That delayed trigger is evaluated against another phase event and does not fire.

scenarios.title: A card with dash can be cast for its dash cost instead of its mana cost

setup.notes: Mardu Scout has mana cost {R}{R} and dash {1}{R}.

decisions: A considers casting Mardu Scout for its dash cost {1}{R}, and for its mana cost {R}{R}.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Casting for the dash cost {1}{R} is legal. Casting for the mana cost {R}{R} is not legal, because A has only one red source.

variants.label: one-land
variants.expected: Casting for the dash cost is not legal because {1}{R} needs two mana. Casting for the mana cost is not legal.

detector.outcome: A card's dash-cost cast is a candidate whose cost is affordable.
detector.near_miss: A dash candidate whose cost cannot be paid.
